claims.hypothesis: A model with continuous equator-to-pole variation describes the CSE better than the flared disk plus jet model
claims.experiment: Fit both the C2006-type flared disk and a new nine-parameter model to the CO(3-2) cube
claims.result: chi2 divided by 2.9; high velocity wings reproduced
claims.finding: No need for expansion confined to a flared disk with sharp boundaries

evidence.loc: Discussion and conclusion
evidence.quote: The new model brings a significant improvement over the flared disk model of C2006 and shows that there is no need for assuming the expansion to be confined to a flared disk having sharp boundaries.

claims.hypothesis: The effective density is strongly oblate
claims.experiment: Allowed a polar density in the fit
claims.result: Polar density at most 13 versus 144 at equator
claims.finding: Effective density drops by at least a factor 10 between equator and poles

evidence.loc: Discussion and conclusion
evidence.quote: We can therefore state that the effective density drops by at least a factor 10 between equator and poles

why_this_method.value: Detailed analysis like C2006 would only repeat earlier work, so they model morphology and kinematics with effective density

evidence.loc: Morphology and kinematics of the observed CSE
evidence.quote: We limit instead our discussion of the present data to the modelling of the morphology and kinematics of the CSE using the concept of effective density

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Adding rotation about the star axis and a velocity gradient gave no significant improvement

evidence.loc: A new model of the CSE
evidence.quote: We checked that accounting for a velocity gradient does not significantly improve the quality of the best fit.

limitations_admitted.value: Model is crude; uncertainties are not reliable quantitatively

evidence.loc: A new model of the CSE
evidence.quote: The relative crudeness of the present model does not allow for a reliable quantitative evaluation of the uncertainties attached to the model parameters.

limitations_admitted.value: Data cannot separate gas density and temperature

evidence.loc: Discussion and conclusion
evidence.quote: The present data do not allow for telling apart the respective roles of actual gas density and temperature in such a strong latitudinal dependence.

referee_caveats_inferred: Single-line, short ACA observation with ~4'' beam limits constraints on the model
Pseudo-uncertainties from 5% chi2 change are not statistical
Effective density conflates density, temperature and excitation
Model degeneracies and the fitting algorithm are not documented
